transaction_fees.note: Priority fees are per compute unit in micro-lamports. Median total assumes a 200k CU transaction with one signature.

fees.note: REV = network fees (DeFiLlama 'Chain' category) + out-of-protocol MEV tips ('MEV' category). app_fees is the separate, much larger figure for fees earned by applications on Solana.

items.title: Samsung Partners with Solana to Natively Deliver Stablecoins in Samsung Wallet to 82 Million U.S. Galaxy Devices
items.summary: Beginning the last week of October 2026, Samsung Wallet will support USDC cross-border transfers on Solana across 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices.

items.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: September 2026
items.summary: September saw growth across tokenized stocks, stablecoins, payments, and DeFi. Tokenized equity supply reached $684 million, stablecoins hit $17.51 billion, and the network processed 3.18 billion non-vote transactions.

items.title: Solana Foundation Launches Solana DvP, an Atomic Settlement Program Built for Financial Institutions
items.summary: Onchain open-source delivery-versus-payment infrastructure, tailored for the world’s leading financial institutions

items.title: Introducing Solana Microscope: Program Monitoring and Alerts
items.summary: Microscope decodes Solana program and Squads multisig activity into Grafana dashboards and alerts for Slack, Telegram, and PagerDuty.

items.title: Solana x AI: The Democratization Layer
items.summary: Solana can give AI agents permissionless access to compute, training, identity, memory, and machine-native payments.

items.title: Solana Changelog: October 1, 2026
items.summary: Devnet lists Alpenglow as a notable feature gate alongside new Agave, Firedancer, Superbank, Web3.js, Kit, and program SDK releases.

items.title: Open USD Is Live on Solana
items.summary: Open USD is live on Solana, letting businesses mint and burn 1:1 for dollars at no cost, with over $1 billion committed to liquidity.

items.title: Slot Time Reduction Effects
items.summary: Solana is now producing slots with a 250ms target, going down from 400ms. In this article we study the effects of this reduction based on direct on-chain measures.
